🦷 Three decisions behind a real clinic website.

Pramukh Multispeciality Dental Clinic in Mehsana had a reputation that was real and entirely offline. Everything a patient understood within a minute of walking in, they had no way of learning at 11 at night on a phone.

So the website had to do the introducing. Three decisions shaped it:

1️⃣ A page for every treatment. Patients don’t search “endodontics”; they search the thing that hurts. Each of the 11 treatment pages opens with the symptom in the patient’s own words.
2️⃣ The whole site in English and Gujarati. Written in both, not machine-translated, and not just the menu.
3️⃣ An enquiry two taps away. A call and WhatsApp bar stays fixed on every page.

It opens in about a second on 4G, measured on a mid-range Android, the phone patients actually hold.

✅ Answer the search in the words it was typed, then make the next step easy.
